paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Rehoboam in gam aphutkip a, mihattak ahong hih nung in amah lam a pang Israel tengteng toh TOUPA Pan alehngatsan uhi.
heading: Aiguptate'n Judah Dou / (1 Kum 14.25-28)
english: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned Yahweh’s law, and all Israel with him.

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa Rehoboam vaihawm akum ngana kum in, TOUPA tung a atatlek ziak un, Jerusalem sim ding in Aigupta kumpipa Shishak ahong kuantou hi,
english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against Yahweh,

paite: Kangtalai singkhat-le-sangnih leh sakol tungtuangmi singguk toh, Aigupta gammi hon zuite sim vual louh ahi uh; Libiate, Sukite, Ethiopiate ahi uhi.
english: with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. The people were without number who came with him out of Egypt: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.

paite: Judah gam a kulh nei khopite ala a, Jerusalem ava tung hi.
english: He took the fortified cities which belonged to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

paite: Rehoboam leh Judahte intekpen, Shishak ziak a Jerusalem a kikaikhawmte kiang ah zawlnei Shemaiah ahohtou a, akiang uah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi, na hon lehngatsanta ua, huaiziak in ke'n leng noute Shishak khut ah ka hon koihta ahi achi," ava chi hi.
english: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and to the princes of Judah, who were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, “Yahweh says, ‘You have forsaken me, therefore I have also left you in the hand of Shishak.’”

paite: Huchi in Israel intekpen leh kumpipa akiniamkhiak ua, "TOUPA adiktat hi," achi uhi.
english: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, “Yahweh is righteous.”

paite: TOUPA'N akiniamkhiak uh atheih in TOUPA thu Shemaiah kiang ah ahong tung a, "Akiniamkhiakta ua; ka hihmang vek kei ding a, khenkhat ka humbit ding a, Shishak zang in Jerusalem tung ah ka hehna ka sungbo kei ding.
english: When Yahweh saw that they humbled themselves, Yahweh’s word came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath won’t be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

paite: Himahleh asikhate ahi ding ua, ka nasep leh gamdangmi nasepdan atheihna ding un," chi in.
english: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.”

paite: Huchi in Aigupta kumpipa Shishak Jerusalem sim in apaitou a, TOUPA' inn a goute leh kumpipa' inn a goute ala a; ala khin vek hi; Solomon bawl dangka-eng lumte leng ala hi.
english: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He took it all away. He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

paite: Kumpipa Rehoboam in huaite tang in dal lumte abawl a, kumpipa' inn kongkhak ngakmi sepaih heutute akemsak hi.
english: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa TOUPA' inn a lut teng in veng mite'n ava pi ua, amah dantan ah akhakik nawn zel uhi.
english: As often as the king entered into Yahweh’s house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard room.

paite: Akiniamkhiak ziak a hihmanthat ahihlouhna ding in atung a TOUPA thangpaihna akiheimangta a; Judah gam leng ahoih gige hi.
english: When he humbled himself, Yahweh’s wrath turned from him, so as not to destroy him altogether. Moreover, there were good things found in Judah.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Rehoboam in avaihawmna Jerusalem ah akipsakta hi: Rehoboam in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmli-le-khat a upa ahi, TOUPA'N amin omsakna ding a Israel nam tengteng lak a atel khopi Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-sagih vai ahawm a; anu min Naamah, Ammon mi ahi.
heading: Rehoboam Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna
english: So King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned; for Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahweh had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

paite: TOUPA zong dia alungsim azat louh ziak in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in Rehoboam tanchin abul a kipan atawp pha in zawlnei Shemaiah gelh tanchinbu ah leh zawlnei Iddo gelh tanchinbu a suante tanchin lak a gelh ahi kei maw? Rehoboam leh Jeroboam bel a kidou nilouh uhi.
english: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, aren’t they written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, in the genealogies? There were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

paite: Huan Rehoboam api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, David khua ah avui ua: asik in atapa Abijah in vai ahawm hi.
english: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city; and Abijah his son reigned in his place.
